description: Does Workspace.Close with one open level and a pending Edit resolve both, what do the held recordset and Database answer, and what does a second Close answer? ws2 = DBEngine.CreateWorkspace(dbUseJet); db2 = ws2.OpenDatabase(main, writable). Fixture r-txn-1b-main-accdb (tables T, S, C, Lv, R, Wide, Big, saved QueryDef QInsMid). BeginTrans; UPDATE Lv SET V = 1 WHERE ID = 1 (dbFailOnError); open dynaset rs2 on SELECT ID, V, Z FROM R ORDER BY ID; rs2.Edit; V = 555; EditMode; ws2.Close; DBEngine.Errors; rs2.EditMode; db2.Name; ws2.Close again; DBEngine.Errors; release rs2, db2, ws2; read R and the Lv sum through a fresh Workspace.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
